description.en:
Speed up any production line: 1x, 2x, 5x or 10x.
Open the Production Chains menu and pick a product. Under PRODUCTION you'll find "PRODUCTION LINE BOOST %" with four tick boxes. Every product has its own setting.
What the boost does: - 1x: everything as normal. - 2x / 5x / 10x: cycles per month and costs per month are multiplied by 2, 5 or 10. - The recipe per cycle does not change, so the line uses 2, 5 or 10 times the materials and makes 2, 5 or 10 times the product each month. - The production's storage (incoming and outgoing) grows by the same amount. Several lines share one storage, so it follows the highest boost set on that production.
Works with every production: base game, maps and mod productions.
Multiplayer: only the farm manager can change the boost. Everyone else sees the setting greyed out. Settings are saved with the savegame.
